# Centre Point School

> > A leading CBSE school group in Nagpur, India, offering holistic education across multiple campuses with international partnerships and a focus on student achievement.

Centre Point School was founded by Mrs. Aruna Upadhyaya and operates multiple CBSE-affiliated campuses across Nagpur including Wardhaman Nagar, Katol Road, and Amravati Road Bypass. The school group emphasizes holistic education through academic excellence, co-curricular activities, social awareness programs, and international collaborations with organizations like the British Council.

## Key Topics

- CBSE curriculum and methodology
- Nagpur campuses (Wardhaman Nagar, Katol Road, Amravati Road)
- Holistic education and CCE assessment
- Student achievements and competitions
- International School Award and British Council partnership
- Social awareness programs (Interact Club, Design For Change)
- Co-curricular activities and sports
- Digital infrastructure and smart classrooms
- Educational leadership (Shilpee Ganguly, Kanchan Ukey, Perveen Cassad)
- Student profiles and success stories
- Online admission process
- Grade conversion tools (CGPA to percentage)
- Academic calculators and educational tools
